label: Diagram 10
caption: Diagram 10 Key dimensions for lobbies with single leaf doors
description: The image is a sheet titled "Diagram 10 Key dimensions for lobbies with single leaf doors". It contains six plan views arranged in two rows of three. Each plan shows a dashed rectangle in the lobby (the wheelchair position) together with two doors, each drawn as a thin leaf and a quarter-circle swing arc, with dimension lines. The labels used are DL1, DL2, "a*", DP1, DP2, 1570mm and L, positioned along the outer edges of the plans. The top-left plan reads DP1, 1570mm, DP2 down its left side and is the only one of the six without L; the other plans carry L and 1570mm on their outer edges, and the door labels DL1, DL2, DP1 or DP2 also appear along the edges of each plan. Below the plans a key in running text states: DL1 and DL2 = door leaf dimensions of the doors to the lobby; DP1 and DP2 = door projection into the lobby (normally door leaf size); L = minimum length of lobby, or length up to door leaf for side entry lobby; "a" = at least 300mm wheelchair access space [can be increased to reduce L]; 1570mm = length of occupied wheelchair with a companion pushing (or a large scooter). A note adds that for every 100mm increase above 300mm in dimension "a" there can be a corresponding 100mm reduction in L, up to a maximum of 600mm reduction.
